reviews.comment: Awful experience. Lecture consisted mainly of watching old YouTube videos. High expectations for someone that doesn't even lecture or upload grades. Take someone else if you can.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. She never uploaded grades onto Canvas. She only returned the midterm via email and even that was finally graded after weeks since submission. She doesn't give you access to grades, so you'll find out if you passed or failed at the very end when final grades are submitted to howdy. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Professor Kallendorf is very kind and enjoys having students participate in conversations in class. The main weekly homework is reading and answering questions from a textbook. The only issue is finding the textbook since it is no longer printed and is an old version. Your best chance at success is actively participating multiple times every class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Kallendorf is an amazing professor. Shes so caring and kind. If you have any issues, you can let her know. She will answer enthusiastically any question you have (especially if its a topic she has researched- she will be excited to let you know all about it). Reading for the class, participating and showing up is important. Best prof. ever!
Make no mistake, she will give you a lot to read and think about. As long as you communicate with her about any struggles or anything you need help with she will go above and beyond for you.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Be ready to read the text, and especially participate in class. There is a lot of room for class discussion in how she formats the class, which became a little difficult when the class moved online due to COVID-19. Additionally, the 2 tests seemed a bit impossible as there were so many questions to answer in such a little amount of time.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: this professor grades very difficult. The avrage class grade on exam 1 was a 75 and the avrage essay grade was a 77. The class avrage on the final exam was a 76.

I took Dr. Kallendorf last spring and I made and A. I absolutely loved her class and her, she is really passionate about what she does and truly cares for her students. She likes when her students participate. Going to class isn't mandatory but going is really going to help your grade. I would definitely take her class all over again if I could!

I love Dr. Kallendorf. Not only is she brilliant, but she is charming, funny, and cares a lot about the subjects she teaches. Her spanish is clear and easy to understand! Class isn't technically mandatory, so you can skip as much as you want, but you'll want to be there in order to succeed and to meet your participation requirements.
